messages.info: Enter the email address you used to register
messages.success: Check your emails for details on how to reset your password.
messages.notfound: Email address isn't registered! Please check and try again
messages.contactAdmin: In this institution password reset is handled in person, not by email. Students, faculty, advisors, jurors and deans must request a new password from the system administrator (or CIECYT). The email channel remains available as a fallback but is not the primary path.
messages.emailWarning: If your account has no email address configured the email flow will not work: contact the administrator directly so they can assign a new password from Users » Reset password.
messages.requiresLogin: To access the reset option you must log in as the system administrator.

steps.title: Procedure when a user forgets their password
steps.step1: The user contacts the system administrator (in person, by phone, or through the CIECYT help desk) and gives their ID number (cédula) or login.
steps.step2: The administrator opens User management, finds the user and clicks Reset password.
steps.step3: The administrator hands the new password over an alternate channel (in person or by phone); the system hashes it on save and records the modification date.

messages.error: Your password couldn't be reset. Remember a password request is only valid for 24 hours.
